query: For my 89-year-old female, among females 84–94 admitted with primary UGIB, what's the IQR of hospital length of stay?
final_sql: SELECT (q3 - q1) AS interquartile_range FROM (SELECT percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS q1, percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY los) AS q3 FROM f) AS q;
